why: The control: the same island level as the world makes it, its connectors on (worlds/connect.mjs: ramps up the cliffs and into the ruin's court, a bridge to the east island, launch pads where nothing else fits). Every area worth going to is reached from the seats and leads back to them, so measure 6 passes; the broken examples fail for the connectors they lack, not because a composed level cannot pass.
